choices.why: Its distressed cognac leather and slim black metal legs give the most authentically aged, industrial look, and the L shape anchors the large open space.
A solid plank wood top on a black metal sled frame is exactly the requested table, and its 135 cm size suits the sectional.
Its warm wood shelves on slim black metal posts match the beams and the table, while its shallow depth keeps the passage next to the door clear.
The black metal swing-arm reading lamp has an industrial character and repeats the dark metal of the other pieces.
It is the only large rug in neutral earthy grey-beige tones, with no pink or bright blue, and it is big enough to go under the sofa and the table.
The woven cushions in dark brown and beige add texture and earthy color against the cognac leather.
This is the requested dark pot, sober and matte, with no gold or bright galvanized finish.

answer.why: Aged cognac leather, warm wood and matte black metal repeat across every piece and talk to the exposed beams and the light floor, creating a cohesive industrial loft without bright white.
